products.name: HP Elitebook 840 g5
products.desc:
Key Specifications

• Display: 14-inch diagonal Full HD (1920 x 1080) anti-glare IPS, available in non-touch (250 nits) and touchscreen variants.
• Processor (CPU): 8th Generation Intel Core i5 (such as i5-8250U, i5-8350U) or Intel Core i7 (such as i7-8500U, i7-8650U) quad-core processors.
• Graphics (GPU): Integrated Intel UHD Graphics 620 (no discrete GPU option).
• Memory (RAM): Configurable from 8GB up to 16GB (or expandable up to 32GB DDR4).
• Storage: 256GB or 512GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD.
• Weight & Build: Weighs approximately 3.25 lbs (1.2–1.5 kg) with a silver aluminum body.
• Audio & Video: Bang & Olufsen upward-firing speakers, HD webcam with privacy shutter, and optional IR camera for Windows Hello facial recognition.
• Ports & Connectivity: USB Type-C with Thunderbolt support, USB 3.0 / 3.1 Type-A ports, HDMI 1.4b, RJ-45 Ethernet, headphone/microphone combo jack, and optional WWAN/LTE slot.
• Security: Fingerprint reader and TPM 2.0

products.name: HP Elitebook 830 G8
products.desc:
Key Specifications

• Processor: 11th Gen Intel Core i5 or i7 (such as the i5-1135G7, i7-1165G7, or i7-1185G7)
• RAM: 8GB, 16GB, or up to 32GB DDR4
• Storage: 256GB, 512GB, or higher NVMe M.2 SSD
• Display: 13.3-inch Full HD (1920 × 1080) anti-glare IPS display (available in standard clamshell or x360 360-degree touchscreen convertible variants)
• Graphics: Integrated Intel Iris Xe Graphics
• Ports: 2 × Thunderbolt 4 (USB-C), 2 × USB-A 3.2, 1 × HDMI 2.0, and a headphone/microphone combo jack
• Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6 (AX201) and Bluetooth 5.0
• Weight & Build: Starts around 1.26 kg with a silver aluminum chassis
• Security & Audio: Fingerprint reader, IR camera (optional), TPM 2.0, HP Sure Start, and Bang & Olufsen speakers

products.name: Dell Yoga 5300
products.desc:
Key Specifications & Features

• Display: 13.3-inch Full HD (1920 × 1080) IPS anti-glare or touchscreen display.
• Processor (CPU): Options range from 8th Gen Intel Core i5 (e.g., i5-8265U, i5-8365U) up to 8th Gen Intel Core i7-8665U vPro, and later 10th Gen Core i5 options.
• Memory (RAM): 2 upgradeable DDR4 SODIMM slots (typically configured with 8GB to 16GB, supporting up to 32GB–64GB).
• Storage: M.2 NVMe SSD (typically 256GB to 512GB).
• Graphics: Integrated Intel UHD Graphics 620.
• Ports: USB-A 3.1, USB-C (with optional Thunderbolt 3), HDMI 1.4, micro-SD card reader, audio jack, and optional RJ-45 Ethernet.
• Build & Security: Polycarbonate/carbon-fiber reinforced chassis (MIL-STD 810G certified), optional fingerprint reader, IR camera for Windows Hello, and TPM 2.0

products.name: Decho 15Kg Top Load Fully Automated
products.desc:
Key Features

• Capacity: 10Kg wash capacity suitable for everyday household laundry loads.
• Fully Automatic Operation: Manages washing, rinsing, and spinning in a single, seamless cycle without manual intervention.
• Top-Load Design: Allows for easy, ergonomic loading and unloading without bending, plus the flexibility to add clothes mid-cycle.
• Wash Programs: Multiple settings to accommodate different fabric types, from delicates to heavily soiled clothes.
• Additional Functions: Features automatic water level adjustment, a quick-wash mode for lightly soiled items, an air-dry function, an LED display, and a child lock.
